findings.claim: Workday named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud HCM Suites for 1,000+ Employee Enterprises for the eleventh consecutive year
findings.source: Workday Newsroom press release, "Workday Named a Leader in 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud HCM Suites...Eleventh Consecutive Year" (newsroom.workday.com)

findings.claim: In the mid-market segment, Workday most often loses competitive deals to Rippling, HiBob, and Dayforce
findings.source: Yahoo Finance, "Workday (WDAY) Faces an AI Threat. Is the Investment Case Broken?"

findings.claim: Some net-new large-enterprise deals are taking longer to close, particularly in Federal, state/local/education (SLED), healthcare, and parts of the commercial market; market is pricing in a software-wide AI reset after Workday's own FY2027 subscription revenue growth guidance slowed to 12%-13%
findings.source: Yahoo Finance, "Workday (WDAY) Faces an AI Threat. Is the Investment Case Broken?" (citing Workday FY2027 guidance commentary)

findings.claim: Andreessen Horowitz published an essay titled "Workday's Last Workday?" arguing AI agents (that can automate HR/finance workflows directly) pose a structural threat to seat-based SaaS incumbents like Workday

Workday holds roughly 19.8%-23.2% share of the dedicated Human Capital Management (HCM) software market, well ahead of SAP SuccessFactors HCM's ~5% share, per 6sense install-base tracking; FY2026 (ended Jan 2026) subscription revenue reached approximately $8.0 billion, growing ~16% YoY
findings.source: 6sense, "Workday - Market Share, Competitor Insights in Human Capital Management" (6sense.com/tech/human-capital-management/workday-market-share)

findings.claim: In the broader ERP category (not just HCM), Workday's tracked install-base share (12.81%) trails Microsoft Dynamics (23.59%), SAP ERP (10.97% for legacy ECC) and SAP S/4HANA (9.96%) is close behind
findings.source: 6sense, "Workday - Market Share, Competitor Insights in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)"

findings.claim: SAP SuccessFactors and Workday are described as the two enterprise HRIS finalists in most 2026 RFPs, with Workday generally winning on unified HR+Finance data model and payroll, while SuccessFactors wins where the buyer already runs SAP S/4HANA (ecosystem lock-in)
findings.source: Redress Compliance, "SAP SuccessFactors vs Workday 2026. HRIS Decision"

competitive_share_entrants.note: share/market-size figures from third-party trackers (6sense) are point-in-time install-base snapshots without a precise publication date; used as directional evidence only, not as GAAP-sourced numbers.

Workday largest customer diversify vendor "in-house" HR system 2026
Workday enterprise customer adds second HCM vendor dual-sourcing 2026
Workday net revenue retention rate decline churn 2026 earnings call

findings.claim: Workday's gross revenue retention rate remained stable at 97% through Q4 FY2026 and again at 97% in Q2 FY2027, indicating no broad-based customer attrition, second-sourcing, or in-housing trend among the existing customer base during this period
findings.source: Workday Q4 FY2026 earnings call transcript (Motley Fool, fool.com) and Workday Q2 FY2027 investor materials (investing.com, "Workday Q2 FY27 slides: AI drives 25% of new sales, margins expand")

findings.claim: No named large enterprise customer of Workday (e.g. Walmart, CVS Health, McKesson, Apple) was found to have publicly announced adding a second HCM/ERP vendor alongside Workday or moving core HR/Finance systems in-house in 2026
findings.source: Multiple queries against news/press-release indexes (erpresearch.com customer list, appsruntheworld.com Workday HCM customer database) returned no such announcement

customer_second_source.note: This axis (customer second-sourcing / in-housing) is templated for component/hardware suppliers with concentrated customers; Workday is a SaaS vendor with a diversified enterprise customer base (no single customer concentration disclosed), so no customer-specific second-source event was found. Reported as found (not not_applicable) because a directly relevant proxy metric (gross revenue retention, a customer-attrition indicator) was located and is reported above.
